content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides information on the cost and dosing of meglitinides, which include nateglinide and repaglinide. The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for these medications ranges from $155 to $878. In contrast, the National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) for these drugs is significantly lower, ranging from $27 to $31. The approved daily doses for meglitinides vary between 360 mg and 16 mg, depending on the specific medication and patient needs.
